criteria.text: Both installed signed architectures pass first launch disabled, enablement/source choice, empty/populated inventories, list/scene selection, archive/restore, Finder/copy and supported exact task/parent navigation.
Switching Rhythm tasks preserves authentication and the existing main/API/engine processes; missing external apps and unsupported task refs report accurately without launching another task.
Quit/relaunch, scanner crash/retry, disable/re-enable, account switch, offline use and low-GPU fallback preserve correct data boundaries and leave no orphan scanner.

An upgrade from the preceding compatible build and rollback/backup restoration retain local preferences and do not alter harness records. Evidence names artifact SHA, app version, OS, CPU and any unpassed case; no required case is silently skipped.

boundary: physical-hardware: qualification requires the CI-signed COL-10 release candidates, native Apple Silicon and Intel hardware, and real Keychain sign-in in disposable macOS accounts. Rosetta, mock Keychain and ad-hoc builds do not count.
